rejected_experiments.decision: rejected: substantial peak-RSS regression; does not isolate coarse writes

rejected_experiments.name: Early shape gate

notes: Nested stage times overlap and are diagnostic only.
Fine tracing localized the penalty to JIT writes and dense tails.
The separate SMT-affinity experiment changes physical-core count and locality together; it does not isolate cache causation.

statistics.timing: Within-process median of samples after excluding warmups; displayed times are medians across five process medians.
statistics.comparison: Geometric mean of five candidate/baseline ratios paired by variant, workers and seed.
statistics.confidence: Exact enumeration of 5^5 paired bootstrap resamples of log ratios, with linearly interpolated percentile endpoints; descriptive, with no multiple-comparison adjustment.
statistics.rss: Maximum process RSS across warmup and samples; includes fixture setup and proof-debug formatting.
limits: Intervals crossing zero are inconclusive, not proof of strict nonregression.
Results qualify the native build, host, affinity and workload tested.
